experiment: E71 CovMix-inspired fixed-reference covariance geometry augmentation on E36 logSPD/WCCN

features.source_note: The requested logspd_raw.npy does not exist; use the actual E36 RAW_PATH constant train_raw_cov5.npy. It contains five un-detrended 171-entry logSPD vectors per trial.
features.post_logspd: E36 per-trial/per-band diagonal detrend followed by population zband standardization

covmix.reference_scope: for each current inner run and frequency band, only covariances from the eight enrolled subjects with trial<=0.60*within-subject/task maximum
covmix.failure_fallback: fixed log-Euclidean initialization for the affected band; record the failure and fallback
covmix.covmix_fit: the identical alpha=0 copy plus three independent augmented copies
covmix.alpha_distribution: independent Uniform[0,1] per fit trial and per copy; the same alpha is shared by the five bands within a trial-copy

model.type: WCCN within-class whitening followed by normalized class-prototype cosine

protocol.source: E65/E54 ten inner runs replicated without CNN, OE, or attacks
protocol.roles: outer_unknown=4, enrolled=8, OE-only=4 (unused), calibration_eval_unknown=4; pairwise disjoint
protocol.subset_rule: sort eligible trials by subject/task/trial/path and take first eight per subject/task
protocol.aggregation: average two inner runs within each outer group, then average five outer groups
protocol.smoke: numerical checks and outer1/inner1 only; never a substitute for the full ten-run evaluation

decision.tau_low: q02 of current inner run clean-known distance ratio; dr<tau_low predicts unknown 0
decision.tau_high: q05 of the same clean-known distance ratio; diagnostic U@95 only
decision.working_U: unknown fraction rejected by the actual q02 rule

numerical_checks.selection: fixed-seed selection from outer1/inner1 enrolled-fit trials; reference remains fitted on all and only that run's fit trials

gates.eligibility_meaning: eligible_for_later_frozen_test only; this experiment still never accesses Test

literature.title: CovMix: Covariance Mixing Regularization for Motor Imagery Decoding
literature.adaptation_boundary: fixed train-fit reference and deterministic alpha=0 inference; no target-session/trial-batch adaptation

reporting.AUC: clean calibration-pseudo-unknown AUROC; larger distance ratio means known
reporting.F1: registered identity macro-F1 direct and with q02 rejection; unknown-class F1 and joint macro-F1 are separate
reporting.evidence_boundary: Train session1 pseudo-unknown subjects and continuous within-session file blocks only; no cross-session or official Test truth evidence; Test=N/A
reporting.attacks: N/A; no CNN, OE training, or adversarial attack in E71
